data.title: What's next Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP's rally cools? | FXStreet
data.description: The cryptocurrency market remains elevated on Tuesday, with Bitcoin (BTC) trading around $85,798, nearly 49% above the year low of $57,756. Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) trade within a robust bullish outlook above $2,700 and $1.51, respectively.
